versions.content: To calculate the possible maximum size for all consecutive SOME/IP TP segments, the SOME/IP TP module shall consider the available buffer size of the upper layer by evaluating the availableDataPtr, provided by the API PduR_SomeIpTpCopyTxData(). I.e.:The payload size of the next SOME/IP TP segment needs to be smaller or equal to the available buffer, AND dividable by 16 for all segments but for the last.

To calculate the possible maximum size for all consecutive SOME/IP TP segments, the SOME/IP TP module shall consider the available buffer size of the upper layer by evaluating the availableDataPtr, provided by the API PduR_SomeIpTpCopyTxData(). I.e.:The payload size of the next SOME/IP TP segment needs to be smaller or equal to the available buffer, AND dividable by 16 for all segments but for the last.
The size for consecutive SOME/IP TP segments all but not the last, shall be derived by the maximum possible size of the segmented SOME/ IP PDUs using the parameter SomeIpTpTxNPduRef.
